description: ΜΕΛΕΤΕΣ ΥΔΡΑΥΛΙΚΩΝ & ΑΝΤΙΠΛΗΜΜΥΡΙΚΩΝ ΕΡΓΩΝ is a dataset listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Δ.Τ.Ε. /Π. Θ.. Κατάλογος Μελετών που αφορούν τα υδραυλικά και τα αντιπλημμυρικά έργα στη Περιφέρεια Θεσσαλίας. Coverage: Δ.Τ.Ε. /Π. Θ.. The portal shows the English title as "PROJEKTY HYDRAULICZNE I PODSTAWOWE" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Δ.Τ.Ε. /Π. Θ.. Its keywords include repository.data.gov.gr, Δημόσια Διοίκηση, Από μετάπτωση. The listing shows 2026-02-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
